title: Ukraine new leader short
question: Should Ukraine get a new president? Comment below!

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Trump just said it's *time for Ukraine to get a new president*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: He blames Zelensky's strikes on Russian refineries for *high diesel prices*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: He could have made many deals, Trump said, but *he never does*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Hours later, Elon Musk wrote that Zelensky *has gone too far*.

scenes.name: Elon Musk
scenes.post: I agree, it's time for Ukraine to get a new leader.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Elon Musk agreed. *Time for a new leader.*

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Zelensky says it's up to *Ukrainians* to choose their leader.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: So what do you think? Should Ukraine get a *new president*? Tell us in the comments.
